contents.text: The enchanted core datapack allows players to absorb and reuse enchantments found naturally on armor, tools and weapons

To start players will want to craft an enchanted core book, this can be obtained by placing in a crafting table: a writable book in the center, 7 lapiz lazuli surrounding it, and a single amethyst shard above the book.
This book has 2 main functions. First, it can absorb enchantments from most enchanted armors, weapons, or tools. The absorbed enchantment gets converted into essence that is stored in the player.
Once you have aquired enough of the coresponding essence, the second function of the book allows you to enchant another item by spending a small amount of essence.
